title: leucas mollissima subsp. chinensis
intro: Leucas mollissima subsp. chinensis, commonly known as Chinese leucas, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chinese leucas include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and combat viral diseases. The bioactive constituents of Chinese leucas include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
